1. i spent four months waiting for someone to notice i was hiding in the stairwell. 2. every lunchtime the yard filled up, but i slipped behind the heavy fire doors with a squashed sandwich. 3. by november the concrete step was cold right through my trousers, but the noise out there was worse. 4. so i just sat in the dim light, counting the bolts on the handrail until the bell rang. 5. but on a wet thursday, you came down the steps carrying a cardboard box of paperbacks. 6. you didn't ask what was wrong, and you didn't tell me to go outside. 7. you just propped the library door open with a brick, and handed me the blue ink stamp. 8. you gave me somewhere to sit without ever making me say i had nowhere to go.
✍️ Caption
some people teach the syllabus, and some notice when a kid is running out of places to stand. twenty years later, i still remember the quiet in that room. send this to the teacher who left their door unlocked at lunch. #childhoodmemories #schoolmemories #teacherappreciation
